rubric.role_summary: Senior art-direction role for Clash of Clans, setting visual direction across the game and wider IP, leading artists, and overseeing external art partners and production pipelines.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior art-direction role for Clash of Clans, setting visual direction across the game and wider IP, leading artists, and overseeing external art partners and production pipelines.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Track record leading art direction on games.
- Experience leading art teams.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Mobile or live-service game experience.
- Experience with cosmetics economies or large seasonal content pipelines.
- Experience connecting game art strategy with marketing or user acquisition, such as key art, trailers, or social content.
- Familiarity with Clash through play or prior work.
- Track record leading art direction on stylised games.
- Experience defining IP and brand frameworks that enable a team to make consistent brand decisions.
- Experience leading collaborative senior art teams, including setting vision and developing artists.
- Strategic experience managing outsourcing pipelines and external partners at scale within live-game timeline and budget constraints.
- Has used AI in day-to-day work.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
No geographic filter: the role is hybrid in Helsinki, Finland (or London), and relocation is provided for hires from any location.
